name: Dot Matrix Chase
description: Two entities travel a spiral path — a bright leader and a dimmer chaser locked in pursuit, never catching, never escaping

variations.name: default
variations.description: A bright leader and dimmer chaser travel the same spiral path 55% of its length apart. Their interlocking tails create a kinetic, predator-prey visual.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the loader in pixels

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the loader in pixels

props.name: dotSize
props.description: Diameter of each dot in pixels

props.name: duration
props.description: Time for one full spiral traversal in seconds

props.name: gridSize
props.description: Number of dots per row and column (n × n grid)
